ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a distribution map of investment by transnational petrochemical enterprises in the Yangtze River Delta region; the legend in the lower left uses different symbols to represent different types, including symbols for “investment companies” and “R&D centers.” Observing the map, it can be seen that these two types of symbols do not evenly cover the entire Yangtze River Delta, but appear more around Shanghai and its surrounding cities, forming an obvious dense distribution area, while other areas have relatively fewer.
